act.long_title: An Act to consolidate, define and amend the law of Evidence.

licence: Published with commentary and other original matter under s.52(1)(q)(ii), Copyright Act 1957.

section.heading: No new trial for improper admission or rejection of evidence
section.html: The improper admission or rejection of evidence shall not be ground of itself for a new trial or reversal of any decision in any case, if it shall appear to the Court before which such objection is raised that, independently of the evidence objected to and admitted, there was sufficient evidence to justify the decision, or that, if the rejected evidence had been received, it ought not to have varied the decision. THE SCHEDULE. –– [Enactments repealed.] Rep. by the Repealing Act, 1938 (1 of 1938), s. 2 and the Schedule.
